correctness.rationale: Exact dispersion E=E_pi+8eta u-(1+4eta)u², u=1+cos k, yields band top E_max=2−2a for a≤1/4 and 2a+1/(4a) for a>1/4. A positive rank-one perturbation creates exactly one simple exterior eigenvalue via 1=epsilon G_a(E), monotonic with divergent G at the upper band edge. At a=1/4+s epsilon^(2/3), E=E_pi+epsilon^(4/3)y, k=pi−epsilon^(1/3)x, the exact denominator rescales to y−4sx²+x⁴/4 and admits uniform compact-y domination by C/(1+x⁴). Thus epsilon G converges locally uniformly to 1/[2 sqrt(y) sqrt(sqrt(y)−4s)], and monotone root bracketing gives t²(t−4s)=1/4, t>max(0,4s). Exact edge shift gives actual band-gap coefficient; s=0 coefficient 2^(−4/3); asymptotic tails checked. Independent numerical quadrature at s=−2,0,1 confirmed limiting Green function=1 near exact roots to ~1e−12.
